polish_changes: Chart cards: added site-wide hover affordance (transition-colors duration-200 hover:border-[var(--ui-text-muted)]) to all 6 cards
StatsBars: added scale prop ('linear' | 'sqrt'); wired scale='sqrt' on Star distribution and Repo age so long-tail bars are differentiable
StatsBars: count labels move inside bar top when bar height >= 16 viewBox units, using fill-bg for contrast against the bar
StatsBars: padding increased (PAD_TOP 8->14, PAD_BOTTOM 24->22) and label sizes bumped (6->6.5/7.5) for legibility
StatsHBar: 1px inset right-border in --ui-bg between segments so opacity-graded segments read distinctly
StatsScatter: padding bumped (PAD_L 28->32, PAD_B 28->30) and axis label font-size 6->7.5
StatsLeaderboard: skill-count rendered as '· N sk' instead of bare '· N' for clarity
stats.vue: chart cards wrapped in <Motion> with fade-up entrance (opacity 0->1, y 4->0, 60ms stagger, easeOut), opacity-only fallback under prefers-reduced-motion via useMotionA11y

self_assessment.weakest_area: Star distribution sqrt scale still leaves bars 2-6 (3, 21, 20, 15, 7) as thin slivers because the 5285:3 ratio is ~1700×; sqrt compresses to ~42× which is better than linear but tail is still subordinate. Going further (cbrt/log) would compress the dominant signal.
self_assessment.hardest_decision: Whether to apply sqrt to Chart 6 (Skills per repo). Skipped because that distribution is reasonably balanced (1336/1338/1786/887/387) and linear is honest. Only Chart 1 and Chart 3 (which has unknown=11353 dominance) get sqrt.

known_limitations: Maintenance and age charts mostly show 'unknown' until repo metadata sync runs
Scatter sampled to top 1,500 skills with non-zero stars or installs
Star histogram is bimodal at 0 and 10k+, reflecting the long tail of personal skill-named repos with no stars
